description: Fixture-backed health, sleep, and focus records: list and log metrics, sleep sessions, and focus blocks.
category_description: Recorded health, sleep, and focus entries.

capability_notes.summary: All actions read or append fixture records; there are no wearables, app blockers, network sync, or live sensors.
Logging a metric appends a health reading with a deterministic metric id and narrative recorded_at.
Logging sleep appends one sleep session with start/end or duration and a quality label.
Logging focus appends one focus block record by label and time range; it does not block apps or websites.
